objective: Test whether temporal stratification of a fixed cheap proxy improves event-F1 AUC at identical exact-oracle budgets under one shared EventRelation materializer.

candidate.name: Proxy-Stratified Temporal Retrieval
selection_rule: For population n and per-video budget B, set M=min(n,B+floor(B/4)).
Partition temporal unit IDs into M cells with boundaries floor(n*c/M).
Keep each cell's maximum-proxy unit; break ties by smaller unit ID.
Rank winners by decreasing proxy then smaller unit ID and return exactly B.

development_evidence.leave_one_domain_out_result: four strict controlled-ARC wins, one tie, zero losses
development_evidence.warning: Four of five domains share realcartest and all labels were open before PSTR was proposed.

external_data.unit_grid: Per video, unit i is the half-open interval [10*i,10*(i+1)); discard a final partial interval shorter than 10 seconds; unit IDs start at zero.
external_data.budget_semantics: Each method receives B unique observations separately on each video, so total logical calls at budget B equal B times the number of primary videos.
external_data.short_video_rule: Videos with fewer than 100 full units are excluded from the primary analysis and reported separately on all feasible budgets without a success claim.
external_data.label_sealing: Video hashes, unit grids, proxy-only tables, PSTR selections, and every label-blind comparator selection must be sealed before any oracle label or event reference is opened.
external_data.reference: Primary references must be human-adjudicated; VLM pseudo-references may be reported only as a secondary analysis.

external_public_proxy.name: roadclip_score_count_v2_frozen
external_public_proxy.aggregation_to_unit: Maximum score_count among proxy clips with nonempty temporal overlap with the ten-second unit.
external_public_proxy.normalization: none after score_count; deterministic ordering is by raw aggregate then unit ID
external_public_proxy.missing_value_rule: If no scored clip overlaps a unit, proxy_score=0.0. Any NaN or non-finite scored value blocks the gate.
external_public_proxy.timeline_offset: All clip and unit timestamps are seconds from the start of the hashed source video; no learned or post-label offset is allowed.
external_public_proxy.seal_requirement: All code/model/config/video/proxy-table hashes and proxy-only columns must be recorded before labels are opened.

shared_evaluation.primary_metric: normalized trapezoidal event-F1 AUC over [5,10,20,50,80,100] independently per video
shared_evaluation.video_aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-video normalized AUCs; each video has equal primary weight regardless of event count
shared_evaluation.secondary_aggregation: event-pooled curves and event-weighted AUC, clearly labeled secondary
shared_evaluation.exact_call_rule: Every primary method must select exactly B unique units on every primary video and use identical oracle observations and materialization.

comparators.pure_proxy_topk: descending frozen raw proxy, unit-ID tie break

arc_shared_k3.name: threshold-0.4 ARC-refinement + proxy-order exact-fill, shared K3
arc_shared_k3.aggregate: For each video and budget, mean event-F1 across the 1000 seeds; then compute per-video normalized AUC. Proxy-fill unqueried units to exact B for every seed.
arc_shared_k3.native_arc: descriptive only and never substituted for the exact-call primary comparator

dpp.name: quality-weighted greedy DPP
dpp.kernel: diag(exp(2*CLIP-rank-percentile)) times normalized-CLIP-embedding Gram times the same diagonal, plus 1e-9 I

supg.exact_fill: append unused units in frozen raw-proxy order until B

comparators.random: 1000 fixed nested permutations with seeds 20260713 through 20261712

decision_rule.strongest_baseline: For each comparator family, compute video-macro normalized AUC. The strongest baseline is the maximum family value, including pure proxy, ARC mean, CLIP, NMS-h10, MMR, facility, DPP, both SUPG variants, and random mean.
decision_rule.primary_effect: PSTR video-macro normalized event-F1 AUC must strictly exceed the strongest baseline.
decision_rule.uncertainty: Using seed 20260713, perform 10000 paired bootstrap resamples of primary videos. The 2.5th percentile of PSTR-minus-strongest-baseline video-macro AUC must be greater than zero.
decision_rule.budget_shape: At no fewer than four of six budgets, PSTR video-macro event-F1 must be no lower than the strongest baseline at that budget; ties count as no lower, not as wins.
decision_rule.distinct_event_check: PSTR must have higher video-macro distinct-reference-event discoveries than the strongest baseline at no fewer than three budgets.
decision_rule.output_efficiency: Report returned seconds, overcoverage, and distinct events at every budget. A primary pass is invalid if a code or configuration audit finds a different materializer or broader per-selected-unit K3 rule.
decision_rule.missing_baseline: If any named primary comparator cannot be sealed and run, the gate is incomplete and cannot pass.
decision_rule.failure_action: Reject PSTR-5:4 without changing its cell overhead, proxy contract, or decision rule using external labels.

claim_limit: A pass would support PSTR under this proxy, query, unit grid, exact-call adapter, K3 evaluator, and sampled video population. It would not establish universal or native-ARC superiority.
